title: HomeMatch
description: A student-focused housing platform for discovering rental rooms and finding compatible roommates. Built with Next.js and Supabase.

title: Orbit System Manager
description: A desktop application for monitoring CPU, memory, GPU and network activity. It combines real-time system metrics with interactive visualizations and a 3D CPU topology view.

title: Statistical Computing Lab
description: An educational workspace combining web development and statistical computing. It brings together web interfaces, a Python API and R learning materials.

title: InfoBoard
description: A keyboard-first browser tab search tool under development. Its planned architecture pairs a browser extension with a local Go native host for tab indexing and search.

title: Admissions CRM Automation
description: A Google Sheets admissions workflow powered by Apps Script. It consolidates records, synchronizes updates and standardizes contact data while tracking source rows.

title: CSV Schema Alignment
description: A Python toolkit for matching corresponding columns across CSV datasets. It combines header normalization, data profiling and similarity scoring to support schema alignment.
